action_items.text: Complete a questionnaire and a summary.
Put up the minutes and project documentation, including the PowerPoint slides.
Receive specific instructions from their personal coach via email.
Note any frustrations or issues that come up in their summary.

decisions.text: Proceed with the presentations in the order they were originally listed.
Exclude teletext from the project scope as it has been taken over by the internet.
Focus the project solely on television remotes to keep complexity low and speed up delivery.
Exclude voice recognition from the remote control features due to cost concerns and lack of necessity for a remote.
Adopt a target group defined by income level and TV ownership rather than specific age demographics.
Include a function to locate the remote if it is lost (e.g., a button that makes it ring or beep).
Include large, accessible buttons for essential functions.
Include a possibility to access extra functions that are hidden or less prominent than main features.
Ensure the remote is fashionable so it is not an eyesore on the coffee table.
Investigate whether the remote needs a battery or if a rechargeable option/charging station is feasible.
Consider the remote's placement in living rooms (e.g., on top of the TV) during design.
